ios.desc:
Features include:
0. Supports iPhone, iPad, MacOS
1. Browse tweets, support more tweet timelines, support homepage tab customization and list tweets
2. Support for displaying long tweets
3. Support for tweet translation
4. Support for posting tweets, send image tweets or text tweets anytime, anywhere
5. Support for online tweet search, support for searching images, videos, or users
6. Support for searching my bookmarks, browse and search my bookmarks anytime, anywhere
7. Support for subscribing to block pornographic scams, making scammers disappear without a trace
8. Keyword filtering of tweets, filter tweets I don't want to see based on keywords
9. Support for automatically hiding inappropriate images in tweets through a powerful machine learning engine
10. Support for loading the highest resolution images, as well as image copying, drag-and-drop sharing, downloading, etc.
11. Support for video downloads
12. Support for space live streaming
13. Multiple dazzling themes for the app
14. The app supports multiple languages including English, Arabic, German, Japanese, Chinese, Thai, etc.
15. ......

-----------------------------------------------

There are two ways to unlock the APP Pro, choose one based on your situation:

PRO page location: Left side ----> Settings ----> Pro

Method 1:

APP lifetime buyout mechanism, one-time purchase, enjoy all Pro features for life

Method 2:
APP continuous monthly subscription mode, free and flexible

【Auto-renewal instructions】

- Subscription period: 1 month (continuous monthly subscription product).

- Subscription price: continuous monthly subscription product is $0.99 per month

- Payment: Auto-renewal products include "continuous monthly subscription", after the user confirms the purchase and payment, it will be credited to the iTunes account;

- Renewal: 24 hours before your membership expires, Apple will automatically deduct the fee from your iTunes account, and the validity period will be automatically extended for one cycle after a successful deduction. If you do not cancel the subscription, Apple will try to deduct the fee periodically during the deduction period. Please pay attention to the subscription and deduction status in a timely manner;

- Cancel renewal: If you need to cancel auto-renewal, please do so 24 hours before the current subscription period expires.

- Cancellation method: For auto-renewal products opened with your Apple ID, go to "Settings" - "iTunes Store & App Store" - "Apple ID" - "View
